summary: xAI announced that Grok 4.5 is now live across grok.com, X, and the iOS and Android Grok apps, and works inside Microsoft 365 apps via add-ins.

practices.reason: Grok is now embedded as an add-in inside Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook, a new integration surface but one that creates no work for teams building on the API.
practices.quote: Grok also works directly inside Word , Excel , PowerPoint , and Outlook with our Microsoft 365 add-ins.
